name: dsh-system-fonts
description: DeepSeek Harness 的纯字体插件：把内容/代码/终端三个系统字体选择器放进通用设置里宿主可折叠的字体区（分别紧跟官方族名行，折叠时一并收起），按字体族枚举 Windows 已装字体，另带行距与字距；字重与字号归宿主主题，文案随宿主语言切换。只改字体，不动配色与版式。 / Pure font plugin for DeepSeek Harness: seats text/code/terminal system-font pickers inside the host's collapsible font region in General settings (each after the official family row it replaces, collapsing with it), enumerating installed Windows fonts, plus line-height and letter-spacing; weights and sizes stay with the host theme and copy follows the host language. Fonts only — no colors, no layout.
author: HwFee <1744567281@qq.com>

scripts.test: node tools/build-client.mjs --check && node test/manifest.test.mjs && node test/fonts.test.mjs && node test/cordis.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/ui-font-role.test.mjs && node test/ui-scale.test.mjs
